one_line: All-in-one funnel builder, email marketing, and online-course platform with a REST API for contacts, funnels, and campaigns.
auth_notes: Auth is an API key generated in account profile settings under 'Public API keys', sent as the X-API-Key header. No OAuth currently (docs state API key is the only auth method). Server-side calls recommended to avoid exposing the key.
self_serve_notes: Free plan exists; API keys generated self-serve in the dashboard. Some endpoints/features may require a paid plan; no approval process.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: ~40 resources: contacts, tags, funnels/funnel steps, campaigns/newsletters, automation rules, booking calendar, courses/enrollments, subscriptions, coupons, webhooks, SMS templates
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhook resource for creating and managing webhook subscriptions

existing_mcp.note: No official or community MCP server found for systeme.io.

evidence.note: Fetched text was a thin help-center shell; API existence and X-API-Key auth verified via curl of api.systeme.io / developer.systeme.io

agent_notes: API is real and documented (OpenAPI available via developer.systeme.io/llms.txt); uncertainty is whether free plan gets API keys and full endpoint access.
